# Tools: one plain list. Each tool joins the list when it is built, and also
# opens from inside a project (batch 3). A tool names itself in the address,
# and carries its whole view there, so that a link opens exactly what was seen
# (batch 4, Part B).
include-in-header:
  - text: '<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">'
resources:
  - workspace.js
  - write.js
  - tools.js

  </noscript>
</div>
